directives.statement: Judge only the static 3D arena environment as a Counter-Strike-like tactical first-person-shooter space. Do not judge gameplay, competitive balance, routes, collision, weapons, controls, HUD, animation, or player skill.

The arena should have a coherent tactical-FPS environmental visual language across architecture, cover, crates, props, surfaces, and level markings. Industrial, urban, training-map, stylized, low-poly, or simplified variants are all allowed; exact fidelity to licensed Counter-Strike assets is not required.

Judge whether abstraction level, material treatment, shading, geometric detail, and color treatment are internally coherent. Mark invalid only when one or more explicit, significant visible style outliers are present; minor variation or ordinary material diversity is valid.

Team-color accents, zone markings, signs, warning colors, and deliberately distinct landmark materials are allowed and must not be treated as style inconsistency merely because they differ from nearby surfaces.
